nodes.name: fly.toml
nodes.summary: Production Fly.io deployment manifest for the Pactify zero-knowledge relay: builds the relay Docker image, exposes HTTP on port 4310 with force_https, pins a single Singapore machine (in-process PairStore + rate limiters do not survive load-balancing), and lets the runtime run Prisma migrations before booting the bootstrap server.

nodes.name: fly.staging.toml
nodes.summary: Staging Fly.io deployment manifest for the Pactify zero-knowledge relay: separate app named pactify-relay-staging in the Singapore region, single shared-cpu-1x machine with 512MB, same HTTP-on-4310 / single-instance constraint as production so in-process PairStore and rate limiters behave identically across environments.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Workspace-root package.json for the cloud pnpm monorepo: private root scoped as @pactify-apps/cloud-root, ESM, pnpm 10.33.0 package manager, Node >= 24 engine pin, recursive build/test scripts, and shared dev dependencies (@types/node, typescript, vitest).

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: pnpm workspace declaration that globs every direct subdirectory of cloud/ (wire, relay, relay-client, crypto, pact-project) into a single workspace so recursive install and filter-based scripts can operate across packages.

nodes.name: tsconfig.base.json
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript compiler configuration extended by every cloud workspace package: ES2022 target with NodeNext modules and NodeNext resolution, strict mode plus noUncheckedIndexedAccess / noImplicitOverride, declaration + sourceMap output, and isolatedModules / verbatimModuleSyntax for safe per-file transpilation.
